summary.text: Vectras Enprocon IPO is a book build issue of ₹53.05 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 40.56 lakh shares aggregating to ₹42.59 crores and offer for sale of 9.96 lakh shares aggregating to ₹10.46 crores.

Vectras Enprocon IPO bidding started from Oct 30, 2026 and ended on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for Vectras Enprocon IPO was finalized on Nov 4, 2026. The shares got listed on the BSE SME on Nov 6, 2026.

Vectras Enprocon IPO is set final issue price at ₹105 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,52,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,78,000.
Beeline Capital Advisors Pvt.ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Spread X Securities Pvt.Ltd.
Refer to Vectras Enprocon IPO RHP for detailed Information.

about.text: Vectras Enprocon Ltd. is a Gujarat-based Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) company operating in the midstream and downstream segments of the Oil & Gas industry. The company specializes in laying pipeline networks, building combined stations, and constructing related facilities across multiple states in India.

Combined Oil and Gas station works: Mechanical, electrical, and civil work in Refineries, petrochemical complexes, Gas Processing Units, Oil & Gas Terminals, and Petroleum Depots. As of August 31, 2025, its unexecuted Order book for Oil & Gas station work stands at ₹15,088.80 lakh.
Midstream and Downstream pipeline projects and related facilities: As of September 30, 2026, its order book for Oil & Gas Pipeline work stands at ₹ 18,327.88 lakh
Other allied services: Civil and infrastructure projects in the Oil and gas industry; electrical, Instrumentation, and Inspection, Testing, and Safety Auditing services in the Oil and Gas Industry.

The company has developed strong capabilities in designing, engineering, procuring, constructing, testing, and commissioning Oil & Gas pipelines and stations. It has completed over 3,34,000 inch dia piping, 785 inch-kilometer pipelines, and 4 combined station projects.
The company serves both public and private oil and gas companies and maintains ISO certifications for quality, safety, environmental, and instrumentation standards.
As of September 30, 2026, the company had 990 employees across multiple divisions.
Track record of timely completion of complex project
Strong Order Book for existing project portfolio and geography
Track Record of Growth in Financial Performance
Experienced management team with significant industry experience
